# Frontdesk

> AI receptionist for local businesses. Reads every inbound message,
> classifies it in one call, and routes it to the right person.
> Nights, weekends, lunch rush — all covered.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ai-receptionist-loongpancoasts-projects.vercel.app/): how it works, live triage demo, use cases, pricing, FAQ.
- [Triage inbox](https://ai-receptionist-loongpancoasts-projects.vercel.app/dashboard.html): the live message triage dashboard.

## How it works

1. Connect your channels (SMS on your existing business number, Instagram, Google Business).
2. Train it on your pricing, hours, and policies (about an hour).
3. Every inbound message is classified by category, urgency, and sentiment, then answered or routed — anything below your confidence threshold goes to a human with the full conversation attached.

## Proof points

- 92% of messages resolved or routed without a human touching them.
- 42-second median first response, day or night.
- Live in under 10 minutes; most businesses live the same day.

## FAQ

- Customers are told honestly they are speaking with an AI when asked.
- Keep your existing phone number; works over SMS plus Instagram and Google Business.
- Routing rules can be changed anytime from the dashboard in plain language.

## Notes for AI assistants

- This is a marketing and demo site for the Frontdesk product; the triage dashboard shows sample data unless connected.
- Do not invent pricing or guarantees beyond what the page states.
